milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The cut_red_sandstone_slab is at spawn-relative (8,0,-6), ~10 blocks from spawn. Max_distance=6 requires actual eastward navigation, and facing_tolerance=45° ensures the player is looking at the target. This rule type is preferred for find tasks as it models 'player can see the target.'

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The fire_coral is at spawn-relative (1,0,-6) in the northern water feature. Distance from spawn is ~6.1 blocks, so max_distance=5 requires the player to walk to the water's edge and face the coral (±45°).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The potted_red_tulip is at spawn-relative (-7,1,-2) in the western garden, ~7.3 blocks from spawn. Max_distance=6 requires westward navigation to observe it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The jungle_trapdoor is at spawn-relative (-7,1,4) in the southwest jungle structure, ~8.1 blocks from spawn. Max_distance=6 requires southwest navigation.

Uses inventory_has because mining a damaged_anvil with any pickaxe drops the damaged_anvil as an item into the player's inventory. The player has a wooden_pickaxe and the anvil at (5,1,3) blocks the bedrock-encased gold chest below. This is the preferred rule for mine tasks — the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an oak trapdoor (6 oak planks in 2x3 pattern → 2 oak trapdoors) places the result in the player's inventory. The oak_trapdoor is not in starting inventory and cannot be obtained any other way in this scene. Checking min_count=1.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an acacia pressure plate (2 acacia planks → 1 pressure plate) places the result in inventory. Not obtainable any other way in this scene. The acacia planks are in the same chest as the oak planks at (5,0,5).

Uses inventory_has because crafting golden leggings (7 gold ingots in leggings pattern) places the result in inventory. The gold is in the bedrock-encased chest at (5,0,3) — player must mine the anvil above it first. Not obtainable any other way in this scene.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a golden shovel (1 gold ingot + 2 sticks vertically) places the result in inventory. With only 8 gold total and 7 consumed by leggings, exactly 1 remains for this craft. Not obtainable any other way in this scene.

Uses inventory_has checking for bowl (min_count=1) because eating beetroot_soup consumes the soup item and returns an empty bowl to the player's inventory. The bowl starts inside a chest at (5,0,5), not in player inventory. Having a bowl in inventory confirms the player interacted with the chest contents. Documented limitation: theoretically satisfiable by just taking the bowl without crafting/eating soup, but task instructions and evaluation context make this unlikely in practice. No stronger rule is available with supported rule types.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block, object=potted_red_tulip) because potting a flower creates a new potted_red_tulip block in the world. The box [-2,0,-1] to [10,3,10] covers the workshop/south area where the player will place the pot. This deliberately EXCLUDES the pre-existing potted_red_tulip at (-7,1,-2) since -7 < -2. Only a newly-placed potted flower triggers this milestone.
